    "Je suis là (Tour)" is the captivating live album by acclaimed Belgian-Canadian performer Lara Fabian. Recorded during her successful 2026 tour, this release captures the unmatched vocal power and deep emotional connection the artist forges with her audience on stage. The repertoire (consisting of 15 tracks) is a nostalgic and renewed journey through her greatest international hits, including heartbreaking classics like "Je t'aime", "Adagio", "Tout", "Immortelle", and the dance anthem "I Will Love Again". A masterful listening experience, extracted directly from Qobuz in audiophile Hi-Res quality (24-Bit), transporting the listener straight to the front row of the venue.
